sources.notes: Only the audio track is used (Vorbis); the video is not scored. Window 20-32 s chosen programmatically as the steadiest segment among Wikimedia Commons tabla recordings: stroke pulse ~0.189 s, median grid residual ~10 ms, pulse-normalised IOI CV ~0.11, bass pattern repeating every 12 pulses (autocorrelation 0.65). Compared against File:Tabla drums demo.oga (CC BY-SA 3.0; fast ~0.10 s pulse, residual 11-30 ms) and File:Excellent Tabla playing by a man.webm (CC BY-SA 4.0; lower grid fit). The taal and bols are not identified by the system and are not asserted. Not reviewed by a tabla expert.
